onboarding.step1Body: Nexus Dominion is a turn-based fantasy MMORPG. Your first task: hunt a monster to gain XP, gold, and your first piece of loot.
onboarding.step2Body: Items dropped during combat land in your bag. Click any equipment piece to equip it — hover to compare stats against what you wear now.
onboarding.step3Body: Sixteen regions await, from Whispering Woods to the Eternal Throne at Lv 350. Each region drops gear from its tier.
onboarding.step4Body: Once you have a few pieces, pour gold into the Forge to enchant them — better odds at lower tiers.

warrior.tagline: Steel and oath. The shield of the realm.
warrior.desc: Heavy armor, devastating melee, sturdy. Excels with sword and shield.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.tagline: The arrow finds what the eye sees.
ranger.desc: Fast, precise, deadly at range. Strikes first; dodges what comes back.

mage.desc: Fragile of frame, fearsome with spell. Channels arcane fire and storm.

rogue.desc: Strikes from shadow, slips out of reach. High crit, high evasion.

help.title: How to Play Nexus Dominion
help.subtitle: A short guide to your first hours in the realm.
help.step1Body: Open <questsLink>Quests</questsLink>. Each quest costs Energy and rewards XP and gold. Hover over a card to see its rewards, region, and minimum level.
help.step2Body: Combat is server-authoritative and turn-based. Speed determines initiative; STR/INT/DEX shape your damage; CON expands your HP. Watch class-specific impact effects on every blow.
help.step3Body: Stats and skills are gold-driven. Each upgrade costs progressively more: 5g → 10g → 15g → 20g… per stat. Visit Character and click +1 or +5 to invest. Each attribute scales on its own counter.
help.step4Body: Loot drops from quests. Sell what you don't need and buy the rest from the <shopLink>Merchant</shopLink>. Equipment goes in 8 slots; rarer rarities glow.
help.step5Body: When ready, enter the <arenaLink>Arena</arenaLink>. ELO matchmaking pairs you against opponents your level. Rating climbs and falls based on outcomes.
help.step6Body: Energy slowly regenerates over time. If you're wounded, head to Character and click Rest to fully heal for 10 Energy.
help.classWarriorDesc: Sword & shield. High HP, steady damage, blocks more.
help.classRangerDesc: Bow. High dexterity, high crit, strikes first more often.
help.classMageDesc: Staff. Glass cannon. Highest top-end damage.
help.classRogueDesc: Dagger. Dodge and crit. Strikes from shadow.
help.mechInitiative: Initiative: higher speed (driven by DEX) acts first.
help.mechDamage: Damage: rolls between your ATK_min and ATK_max. Class-specific stat (STR/DEX/INT) adds the rest.
help.mechCrit: Critical hits: ×1.8 damage. Crit chance scales with DEX and weapon skill.
help.mechDodge: Dodge: prevents a hit entirely. Scales with DEX and Stealth skill.
help.mechBlock: Block: occasional 60% damage reduction for shielded fighters.
help.mechLoss: Loss penalty: −10% gold, dropped to 1 HP (never killed permanently).
help.tipEquip: Equip everything you can the moment you can — stat bonuses stack.
help.tipPotions: Carry potions; they can save you mid-quest.
help.tipHp: Crit happens; bring more HP than you think you need.
help.tipRest: Rest before tougher quests; entering wounded is risky.
help.tipMap: The <worldLink>World Map</worldLink> shows where each region's level range lives.
help.tipHistory: Past fights can be re-watched in <historyLink>Battle History</historyLink>.

landing.heroEyebrow: A Browser MMORPG · Free to Play · No Download
landing.heroTagline: A realm with a long memory.
landing.heroSubtitle: Four classes. Sixteen regions to push through. Ten tiers of gear, an ELO arena, an auction house that runs in real time, and a Tower of Trials whose leaderboard updates while you sleep. Free, browser-based, no installer. Sign up takes thirty seconds.
landing.featuresTitle: Twelve loops, all running at once.
landing.featuresLead: You log in for ten minutes and have to choose: clear a dungeon stage, settle an auction listing, push the daily bounty, or finish a tower run before the leaderboard rolls over. Every loop pays out separately, every loop matters.
landing.featCombatBody: Server-authoritative turn-based duels resolved in under thirty seconds, with a 3D stage, real particle bursts, and a damage-scaled screen shake. Replays available after every fight.
landing.featGuildsBody: Five guild tiers, each multiplying member XP, gold, crit, and dodge. Officers can declare 24-hour wars on rivals; raid bosses scale to your roster size and pay every participant.
landing.featQuestsBody: Sixteen scripted quest lines across five regions. Outcomes you choose alter rewards, unlock follow-ups, and feed into Bestiary completion.
landing.featDungeonsBody: Four scripted dungeons plus ten procedural high-tier bands. Bring potions, eat damage between rooms, take the guaranteed clear drop home.
landing.featCosmeticsBody: Twelve hand-painted avatars and twelve rarity-tinted frames, each tied to a real achievement. No frame is for sale.
landing.featProfilesBody: Bio, avatar, frame, title, public combat history. Easy to look up, harder to forge a reputation on.
landing.featHuntingBody: Pick a region, pick a window. Each kill rolls a 22% drop and counts toward bounty, battle pass, and weekly trial in one go.
landing.featArenaBody: Matchmade duels against sixteen NPC trainers and every player at your rating band. K=32, so a streak shows up fast.
landing.featDailyBody: Seven-day streak cycle with gem milestones at day fourteen and thirty. Miss a day and the streak resets; nothing is sold back to you.
landing.featWheelTitle: One spin a day, no shop
landing.featWheelBody: The wheel pays in gold, XP, potions, energy, or a 500-gold jackpot. It's not a lootbox; it's a budgeted bonus.
landing.featAchievementsBody: "The Worldslayer", "Hero of the Realm", "Loremaster". Titles render next to your name across the realm.
landing.featSetsBody: From the Wayfarer's Garb to Solar Mythwoven. Two-, four-, and six-piece bonuses reshape a build; mixing tiers is encouraged.
landing.classesTitle: Four classes, with the math written down.
landing.classesLead: Each class has a stat ramp, a weapon skill tree, a damage type, and its own impact effects in combat. You re-spec the build whenever the season changes.
landing.classWarriorTagline: Eats hits, returns them with interest. Sword and shield, plate, calm under pressure.
landing.classRangerTagline: Hits first, harder than you expected, from where you weren't looking. Bow, leather, fast hands.
landing.classMageTagline: Slow opener, large finisher. Burns mana fast, ends fights faster. Staff, robes, library card.
landing.classRogueTagline: Crit-heavy duelist. Dodges everything until it can't. Dagger, dark cloth, no questions.
landing.setsTitle: Eight themed sets. Every piece dropped, never bought.
landing.setsLead: Wear the same set to unlock two-, four- and six-piece bonuses. Mix tiers for hybrid builds. Nothing in this section is on the gem shop.
landing.setWayfarerLore: Boiled leather and stitched hide. Every hero's first kit.
landing.setIronguardLore: Issue of the Iron Watch. Standard for bridge and tollroad duty.
landing.setSylvanLore: Forest-dyed leathers worn by the marshals of the Whispering Woods.
landing.setArcaneLore: Spell-thread robes granted to junior members of the Conclave at Aedric.
landing.setNightveilLore: A killer's wardrobe. Charcoal hood, black-dyed plate, soft-sole boots.
landing.setSunforgedLore: Quenched in the Ember Spire kilns. The plate has burn marks the smith did not put there.
landing.setVoidshardLore: Robes embroidered with shards of cooled void-glass. The hem hums when read aloud.
landing.setSolarLore: Worn by the first Hero of the Realm. Found three centuries later in a sealed barrow.
landing.endgameTitle: The realm keeps moving while you're logged out.
landing.endgameLead: Past the act-one tutorial the realm runs on weekly cycles. Server-wide bosses, faction reputation tracks, the auction, weekly trials. Three months of named content from your last APEX kill to the cap, and the systems below carry you through it.
landing.egRealmBossBody: Six bosses on a rotating week. The realm shares one HP pool; you can strike once every four hours. The hero who lands the killing blow earns a one-of-a-kind legendary; everyone who hit it splits gold, gems, and XP at settlement.
landing.egFactionBody: Three factions — Iron Watch, Conclave, Wyrmkin — track rep separately. Hit the matching enemy family and your standing climbs. Six rep tiers; each one unlocks a piece of vendor stock that nobody else can reach.
landing.egApexBody: One unique drop per region APEX boss, mid-tier and divine combined. Guaranteed on first kill; the kit-defining items at every band. Sixteen named regions, eleven APEX kills to collect.
landing.egTowerBody: A trial floor that resets weekly. Climb as far as you can on a single run. Your best floor goes on the leaderboard and feeds back into Wyrmsong, the only weapon in the realm that scales with your tower climb.
landing.egCacheBody: Fifty kills a week unlocks a tier-appropriate equipment drop plus scaling gold and ten gems. Resets Mondays at midnight UTC. Skip one week, no harm; the cache is yours when you come back.
landing.egAuctionBody: One legendary listed per hour, server-wide. Gem-bid only; only the winner takes it home. You don't have to be online when the hour rolls over; settlement is automatic.
landing.egMythicBody: Cleared a scripted dungeon? Re-enter on the Mythic+ track. Enemy stats scale 12% per tier, and every tenth tier guarantees a tier-9 loot-pool drop. Five consecutive failures pity-unlocks the next tier, so the climb never stalls.
landing.egEventsBody: Frostmoot, Bloomtide, Sunhigh, Emberfall. A month-long window each. Kill the season's target family for points; redeem at the event vendor for a cosmetic frame, a painted avatar, a season mount, and a tier-9 season trophy.
landing.forgeLead: Drop a piece on the anvil and pay gold to raise its stats. The cost ramps; the failure rate is published; pity-protection guarantees a success after enough attempts. Higher tiers unlock sockets and rerolls. Nothing is hidden behind a wall of premium currency.
landing.guildsTitle: A guild is the cheapest power upgrade in the game.
landing.guildsLead: 1,000 gold to found. Up to thirty members at tier five. Five tiers of multipliers on XP, gold, crit, dodge, HP, charisma. Donate gold to climb officer track, declare a 24-hour war against a rival, raid a server boss with thirty friends and split the pot.
landing.gTiersBody: Tier one to tier five. Each tier widens the roster (ten to thirty members) and multiplies XP, gold, crit, dodge, and HP for everyone wearing the crest.
landing.gChatBody: Polled every four seconds, avatars rendered inline, leader and officer roles with kick, promote, demote. No external app needed.
landing.gWarsBody: Officers declare a 24-hour war for 500 guild gold. Members hit enemies for score. Higher score at the deadline wins, both rosters get a payout, nobody gets banned.
landing.gRaidsBody: Sentinel of Dawn, Maw of Voidshade, Colossus Unbound. Boss HP scales with active roster. Each member's damage is logged; cleared raid pays everyone proportionally.
landing.gCrestBody: Two-to-five-character tag, a hex-picked crest colour, an optional motto. Renders next to every member's name in every public list.
landing.gTreasuryBody: Donate gold; each piece is one guild XP and one contribution point. Officer track is opened by total contribution, not by who knows the leader.
landing.worldTitle: Sixteen hand-built regions, all the way to three hundred and fifty.
landing.worldLead: Five act-one regions, six mid-tier regions, five divine endgame regions. Every monster is named, every region has an APEX boss with a unique legendary drop. No procedural filler; no "Cinder Marauder · Lv 247" anywhere in the realm.
landing.regionWhisperingBody: Goblins, dire wolves, the rats under the inn. The first place you draw a sword.
landing.regionMistmoorBody: Fog-laced highlands where the orcs raid down for cattle and the trolls don't bother hiding.
landing.regionCrystalBody: A dwarven dig that broke into something it shouldn't have. The Overlord sleeps at the bottom.
landing.regionAshenBody: Burned earth from a god's argument. Revenants walk it because nothing else will.
landing.regionShadowfellBody: The Shadow Lord's court. End of act one; first APEX kill of your career.
landing.regionEmberreachBody: Volcanic frontier. Wyrmkin clans rule it. APEX: Khalad the Wyrm-Touched.
landing.regionHammerhandBody: A dwarven mining city overrun by its own. APEX: Gorvak the Iron Tyrant.
landing.regionConclaveBody: A magical academy in open rebellion. APEX: Archlector Vex.
landing.regionSaltmarshBody: Lizardfolk swamp under the Sunken King. APEX: the King himself.
landing.regionFrostvaleBody: Arctic tundra ruled by frost giants. APEX: Jarl Snowtooth.
landing.regionBlackSpireBody: Demonic incursion at the mountain's peak. APEX: Azhtek the Black Pyrelord.
landing.regionStormpeaksBody: Sky-piercing mountains, storm elementals, sky-pirate clans. APEX: Skyfather Karna.
landing.regionVoidshadeBody: A crack in reality. Aberrations that should not be. APEX: Caethra, the Voidshade Heart.
landing.regionMooncradleBody: Floating lunar isles under a pale court. APEX: Selan, the Pale Empress.
landing.regionWorldspineBody: The mountain that is the backbone of the world. APEX: Vhastar, the Spine-Wyrm.
landing.regionEternalBody: The god's last court. End of the road. APEX: The Unname, God-of-Endings.
landing.rmCoreBody: Four classes, 240+ items, eight themed sets, sixteen hand-built regions covering level one to three hundred and fifty, eleven unique APEX boss drops, six weekly Realm Boss legendaries, three factions with six rep tiers each, thirty-eight named quests, four scripted dungeons plus Mythic+ endless tiers, four seasonal events with their own cosmetic + trophy vendors, ELO arena, daily and weekly loops, achievements, bestiary, replays.
landing.rmProfileBody: Twelve avatars, twelve rarity-tinted frames, bios, name change, public profile pages, title selector. All cosmetics are earned in play.
landing.rmGuildsBody: Five-tier guild system, live chat, declared wars, scaling raid bosses, donation ledger, treasury, member management, crest editor.
landing.rmCombatBody: Three.js stage with EffectComposer post-processing, hit-flash, HP-bar drain, hit-stop on crits, damage-scaled screen shake. Reduced-motion respected throughout.
landing.rmCraftBody: Smithy, alchemy, gem socketing, recipe drops from elite kills. Same anti-paywall policy: no recipe behind premium currency.
landing.rmEventsBody: Weekend boss invasions, faction wars, server-wide tournaments. Prize pools paid in earned gold. No premium currency, ever.
landing.finalTitle: Sign up. The watch needs another sword.
landing.finalBody: No installer, no paywall. Thirty seconds and you're in Aedric.
landing.footerTagline: A modern, server-authoritative browser MMORPG. Free to play. No premium currency.
landing.footerCopyright: © Nexus Dominion. A free-to-play browser MMORPG.
landing.footerMade: Made with care for hero-class storytelling.
landing.step3Body: Twenty-one regions await, from Whispering Woods to The First Light at Lv 500. Each region drops gear from its tier.
landing.regionBeyondBody: Five realms past the world's ending — ash, fallen stars, the forge of the next dawn, the unlit court, and the first light itself. Lv 351–500.

intro.line1: The road north is open again.
intro.line2: Six kingdoms paid for it. None will say with what.
intro.line3: You start at Aedric, with a sword borrowed from the watch and a name nobody knows yet.
intro.line4: There is a tower at the end of the road. Climb it, and the realm learns your name.
